# Wayforge Campers

> Wayforge hires out two fully self-contained Toyota LandCruiser Troopcarrier (VDJ78 "Troopy") 4WD campers from Perth, Western Australia. Bookings are made through Camplify.

Key facts:

- Vehicles: two Toyota LandCruiser 70 Series Troopcarriers (VDJ78), manual transmission, 4.5L V8 turbo diesel, 180L fuel capacity.
- Roof conversions: one has an Alu-Cab Hercules roof conversion (sleeps 2 adults + 1 child); the other has a Headspace Campers roof conversion (sleeps 2 on a full-length bed). Both have full standing height when the roof is raised.
- Interior: both have an Odyssey Custom Fitouts interior with a pull-out kitchen and cookware, fridge/freezer, 200Ah lithium battery with solar, a water tank, bedding, camp chairs and table, and an awning.
- Price and hire terms: from $280 per night, minimum hire 2 nights, no kilometre limit.
- Pick-up and drop-off: Perth metro area; the exact handover location is confirmed at booking.
- Drivers: minimum age 21, with a standard Australian manual car licence or an international licence. 4WD experience is recommended before going off-road.
- Insurance and support: through Camplify, including off-road protection options and 24/7 roadside assistance. Remote tracks and water crossings are not covered by insurance.
- Suggested destinations: Exmouth and Ningaloo Reef, Karijini National Park, Esperance and Cape Le Grand National Park, Margaret River.
- Contact: info@wayforge.com.au. Enquiries and bookings go through Camplify.
